t: This is the address of the World Crafts Council, a non-profit organisation founded in 1964 to encourage the economic development of crafts and to strengthen the standing of craftspeople. Three women are named among its founders. Kamaladevi Chattopadhyay was an Indian social reformer who promoted handicrafts and handlooms. Aileen Osborn Webb was an American patron of crafts. Margaret Merwin Patch was an American arts administrator and statistician. UNESCO accredited the council in 2020.
